title: The Deep Stone Where No Echoes Forever

features.name: the-refusal-standing
features.desc-on-touch: A monolithic glyph of refusal, repeated in rows down into darkness you cannot measure. The stone does not echo because it has learned to absorb every question.

features.name: the-pressure-weight
features.desc-on-touch: The sediment-layers above have pressed this chamber so completely that sound itself has learned to stop before it arrives. You feel the weight of refusal in your bones.

features.name: the-ancient-boundary-line
features.desc-on-touch: A fence of impossible stone, marking where the earth decided to hold fast. The line goes deeper than sight, a boundary that will not negotiate.

inscription: the stone learned to say no, and did not need to repeat itself

file.name: Sediment_Pressure_Log_FinalEntry.txt
file.note: Every meter down: resistance increases; sound attenuates; the refusal becomes more complete, more eloquent

exits.label: upward to the place where the earth first learned to refuse
downward, if the stone permits, into what the earth keeps below its refusal
along the boundary, where other pressures have left their marks
